correctness.rationale: Exact linear word definition, complete all-integer boundary cases, normalized prefix forced by the published lemma, and a bijection with open Euler trails whose edge multiplicities and factorial terms are checked. Full de Bruijn rooted-tree count follows from P^m=J/2^m, and the second-position vertex-deletion ratio follows from the explicit finite overlap inverse K and its evaluated three-by-three determinant. A standalone no-dependency verifier checks direct word counts at n=2..4, exact graph matrix-tree minors at n=4..7 and rational inverse ratios at n=4..12. Finite checks supplement rather than replace the symbolic proof.
